question: What great attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as a single attainment.
This attainment is described as a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation renders one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: The great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may make one dear to the yoginīs.
